components.name: Theme Pill Button
components.description: Floating pill toggle switching between Sweet Pink and Romantic Dark moods.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); color: #4a0e17; border: 1px solid rgba(217, 64, 107, 0.35); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: #d9406b; } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9406b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Keepsake Card
components.description: Translucent rounded container for letters, milestones, and cherished qualities.
components.html:
Your Smile

The one that made me fall — and still does, every single day.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); border: 1px solid rgba(217, 64, 107, 0.28); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; color: #4a0e17; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(74, 14, 23, 0.08); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(217, 64, 107, 0.16); }

narrative.overview: Anniversary Terus is an intimate, editorial romantic keepsake designed to feel like a handwritten letter pressed between silk-textured pages. Rather than a generic dashboard or loud neon template, it pairs airy Cormorant Garamond serif typography with light-weight Raleway body copy over two cohesive atmospheric moods: Sweet Pink (default daylight sakura paper) and Romantic Dark (evening burgundy velvet).
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif display voice (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300, italic accents) paired with clean humanist sans (Raleway).
Tinted translucent surfaces with crisp hairline borders and soft ambient shadows.
Purposeful, reduced-motion-safe interactivity (gift box reveal, LoveLoom orbit, floral wish tooltips, audio visualizer).

rules.name: The Single-Accent Discipline Rule
rules.body: Rose Primary (#d9406b) and Rose Glow (#ff96b4) are the sole interactive accent colors per theme. Never introduce unrelated blue, purple, or neon hues.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Long-form letter paragraphs and descriptions never exceed 65ch in width so lines remain effortless to scan on wide viewports.

rules.name: The Offset-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow includes a positive Y-offset and soft blur; avoid zero-offset neon halos on static containers.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables (var(--text-primary), var(--text-secondary), var(--surface-card), var(--accent-primary)) so components work in both pink and dark themes automatically.
Do use exponential ease-out curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) or cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)) for all reveals, modals, and hover transitions.
Do provide aria-label, keyboard activation (Enter/Space), and visible :focus-visible rings on all interactive elements.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce across CSS animations, canvas petals, and cursor trails.
donts: Don't use bounce or elastic easing (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) or animate-bounce).
Don't hardcode dark-only hex colors (#ffc8dc, #fff8f3) in components without semantic token mapping.
Don't render raw debug text, git conflict markers, or unstyled browser defaults (scrollbars, range inputs, focus outlines).
Don't rely on :hover alone for essential content like flower wishes on touch devices.
